why: All three checks positively confirm the finding. (1) QUOTE VERBATIM: curl -sL of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/discover-plugins.md yields the sentence at line 158, character-for-character. Reading the WHOLE line: it is a two-sentence line whose first half is 'Go to the **Discover** tab to see plugins from the marketplace you just added.' followed by an MDX marker '{/* min-version: 2.1.154 */}' and then the quoted sentence. Neither the first sentence nor the marker reverses the conclusion; the marker only dates the feature to Claude Code v2.1.154+. (2) CLAIMED BEHAVIOUR is accurate and is corroborated by two sibling pages, not over-read from this one: settings.md:302 defines pluginSuggestionMarketplaces as '(Managed settings only) Marketplace names whose plugins can appear as contextual install suggestions. No marketplace-declared suggestions surface without this allowlist ... Suggestions come from each plugin's `relevance` declaration in its marketplace entry.', and plugins/marketplace-reference.md#entry-and-plugin-json (was line 221 of the retired plugin-marketplaces page) defines the entry field: '`relevance` | object | Signals that tell Claude Code when to suggest this plugin to users. Takes effect only for marketplaces an administrator allowlists in managed settings.' (min-version 2.1.152). (3) OUR STATE confirmed. `grep -rna pluginSuggestionMarketplaces` over the repo (excluding node_modules/.git/.codegraph) hits ONLY plan and spec prose -- docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-marketplace-entry-authority.md:230, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-deviation-register.md:183, and the sweep's own JSON data files. Zero source readers. `grep -rna relevance` over packages/*/src and apps/*/src hits only a quoted doc sentence in plugins/types.ts:832, its echo in a test header, one negative-assertion test fixture, and the unrelated fuzzy-search scorer (search/fuzzy.ts) -- a sibling-subsystem homonym that is NOT this feature. The drop is deliberate and mechanised: external-catalog-adapters.ts:153-166 declares MARKETPLACE_ENTRY_CARRIED_FIELDS as an explicit allowlist ('Deliberately an ALLOWLIST, not a copy of the entry'), and the loop at :235-255 copies only allowlisted keys into `fields`, so `relevance` never reaches the plugin definition. external-catalog-adapters.test.ts:419 pins it with a fixture commented 'Not a field any adapter reads -- must not travel with the definition' and asserts the carried key set is exactly ['description','mcpServers','skills','version']. ONE LAYER UP/DOWN: the consequence is verified separately from the identifier and holds. Nothing upstream already handles it -- the sibling managed marketplace keys ARE implemented (registry-source.ts:177 strictKnownMarketplaces, :191 extraKnownMarketplaces, wired at :304-327 and :390), so managed marketplace policy generally works and only the suggestion allowlist is missing; and nothing downstream consumes relevance -- `grep -rina suggest` across marketplace/ and plugins/ finds only `suggestedNextSteps` (post-install next-step prose in repository-install.ts:48/72 and types.ts:436) and a service.ts:178 prompt string, none of which is a contextual install-suggestion surface. NOT AN EXEMPTION: this is not one of the nine dated owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (those are SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, listSessionSummaries/listSessions), and it is not a deliberate product difference of the fork -- it touches neither the dropped Claude/ChatGPT subscription flows, nor the corporate-gateway targeting, nor the NESSY_ rename. It is a genuine, accurately-stated divergence that the finding itself already labels a recorded deferral; a deviation-register row documents a divergence, it does not cancel one.
correctedState: Confirmed as stated, with one evidence refinement. The cited line packages/shared/src/marketplace/external-catalog-adapters.ts:160 is the array member 'defaultEnabled', not the drop itself; the governing mechanism is MARKETPLACE_ENTRY_CARRIED_FIELDS at :153-166 (an explicit allowlist) applied by the copy loop at :235-255, which never sees `relevance`. Pin the behaviour to external-catalog-adapters.test.ts:405-431, which asserts the carried key set is exactly ['description','mcpServers','skills','version'] for an entry that declares relevance. The scope of the gap should also be narrowed: managed marketplace policy generally IS implemented (strictKnownMarketplaces and extraKnownMarketplaces at registry-source.ts:177/:191, wired at :304-327 and :390); what is absent is specifically (a) the pluginSuggestionMarketplaces managed key -- zero source readers repo-wide -- and (b) any contextual install-suggestion surface for cwd-relevant plugins to be pinned into. The 'relevance' hits in packages/shared/src/search/fuzzy.ts are the unrelated fuzzy-search scorer and must not be read as a partial implementation. Feature is Claude Code v2.1.152 (field) / v2.1.154 (Discover-tab pinning) or later. Reason on record: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-marketplace-entry-authority.md:230, surfaced as deviation-register line 183.
